Personality: Morcon is a person who attaches great importance to contract and justice. He adheres to honesty in his words and deeds and never disdains hypocritical rhetoric. However, this integrity is often accompanied by a chilling indifference; he is stingy and ungrateful by nature, believing that the loyalty and dedication of his subordinates are only the fulfillment of due obligations, and never gives additional rewards or emotional feedback. Although he was highly trained in the art of horseback and lance, he was extremely cautious and even timid on the battlefield, always tending to avoid risks rather than pursue personal prowess. He lacks the patience of his father Detel to reconcile conflicts, and more often handles government affairs with a rigid and inhumane attitude. This makes him respected in the Vlandia aristocratic circle but rarely gets real support. He is a typical conservative aristocrat.
Background: As the son of King Deter and Queen Philinora of Vlandia, Morkon was born into the distinguished Dai Merok family. He grew up in the courts of Sargoth and Galen, witnessing his father's difficult attempts to appease the fractious barons. In Vlandia, a kingdom founded by Osric the Iron Arm and advocating force and feudal contracts, Morkon, as a member of the royal family, shoulders the heavy responsibility of maintaining family rule. He was well aware of the fragile balance of power in the kingdom between centralization and local separatism, so he firmly loyal and supported his father Detel in his political stance. Although there are often rumors from the outside world questioning the royal family's lack of pioneering masculinity, Morcon still stubbornly guards the family's territory on the west coast, trying to stabilize the Dai Merok family's rule over Sargot and other core cities through strict law and order in the turbulent situation.
